name: Bundelkhand Data Centre Cluster (BIDA area) - proposed
developer: Government of Uttar Pradesh / Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA)
notes: On 21 May 2026 CM Yogi Adityanath directed officials to explore a major data centre cluster in the Bundelkhand Industrial Development Authority (BIDA) area as part of the Uttar Pradesh Data Centre Cluster (UPDCC) strategy (target: 5 GW AI compute corridor by 2040). BIDA's operational area covers all seven Bundelkhand districts including Chitrakoot; no specific site or capacity has been allocated to any district yet. Swarajya (Jul 2026) notes the UP Data Centre Policy 2026 offers a 50% land subsidy in Bundelkhand but that no data centre has so far been built in the region. Regional/state-level proposal only.
